DitherEclipse.center: Centre of the disc, as fractions of the box from the top left.
DitherEclipse.size: Radius of the disc, as a share of the box height.
DitherEclipse.corona: How far the corona reaches past the rim, 0 to 1.
DitherEclipse.light: Where the rim is brightest, in degrees as in CSS: 0 is the top.
DitherEclipse.pulse: How much the glow breathes, 0 (steady) to 1.
DitherEclipse.rim-color: Colour of the rim and corona.
DitherEclipse.sky-color: Colour of the sky and the disc.
